passages.title: Complaint about my order
lines: I am writing to complain about my last order. I ordered 24 desk lamps on May 4, and they were due last Monday. I called your office on Wednesday, and the order eventually arrived on Thursday, three days late.

When we opened the boxes, we discovered that six lamps were badly damaged and two more do not turn on. Some of the other boxes were slightly damaged too. I took pictures of everything and attached them to this email.
I have been your customer for five years, and I am very disappointed. I have a big sale next weekend, so this is a real loss for my store.
Please send a replacement by next Wednesday, or give me a refund for the eight lamps.

questions.en: How many lamps have a problem?

questions.zh: Mr. Grant 希望公司怎麼做？

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 他幾乎從來不抱怨，所以這次很嚴重。

scene.speaker: npc

lines.en: Two of the lamps are defective. They don't even turn on.

lines.zh: 我們也會寄一張折價券給您，下次訂貨打九折。

lines.en: Thank you. That's very kind of you.
